title: V1 · GLACIER GATEWAY
detail: Direction: sculpted glacier landscape, dramatic but bright glacial-blue identity. A large curved natural ICE ARCH is the main landmark at the rear, rising above a continuous lower cliff so its opening is scenic rather than an escape gap. Layered opaque blue ice cliffs, frosted fractured surfaces, short stout icicles, irregular white snow cornices. A broad frozen waterfall on a rear side wall ends in a shallow peripheral ice shelf, never cutting through the arena. One walkable side ledge with low stone edging, a short ice-and-stone bridge and easy stairs all outside the central field. Sparse snow-laden dwarf pines, faceted glacier boulders, low ice crystal clusters and warm brass lanterns. Entrance: two rugged snow-capped stone piers with ice insets, no elaborate roof. Colors ice blue, pale cyan, slate blue, white, tiny warm amber accents. Sunny clear morning, soft blue shadows. Most naturalistic of the three, no lodge buildings.

title: V2 · ALPINE EXPEDITION
detail: Direction: cozy alpine mountain expedition setting with clear vertical structure at the perimeter. Hero landmark is a large jagged SNOW-CAPPED MOUNTAIN RIDGE hugging the rear ring, with blue-gray exposed rock strata. On a side terrace nestles ONE small inviting timber expedition hut with teal roof, heavy snow cap, amber windows, stacked supply crates and a rolled rope. A short curved wooden overlook walkway and small rope bridge connect two peripheral rock ledges reached by broad stairs; stay clear of the center. Snow-laden layered fir trees provide asymmetrical silhouette groups, squat weathered trail posts and a few frost boulders. The entire boundary is a continuous low mountain/snowbank base, not a loose tree fence. Entrance is a simple chunky timber trail arch with snow atop and two lanterns. Palette white, blue-gray stone, desaturated pine green and warm honey timber. Crisp daytime sky, warmer and welcoming than V1. The flat central field is snow, not a frozen lake. No giant ice arch and no dominant crystal formation. Practical modular snow cliffs, pine tree variants, hut kit and rope-bridge kit should look custom modeled.

title: V3 · FROZEN CRYSTAL BASIN
detail: Direction: magical yet buildable winter crystal basin, more mysterious and striking than the other two. A rear-side cluster of massive faceted FROST CRYSTAL SPIRES rises from dark indigo rock capped with thick snow, as the main skyline landmark. An opposite side features a sculpted curled glacier ridge and a small shallow ice grotto, luminous cyan inside, closed by a solid back wall. A ring of snowy slate cliffs contains the region; broken blue-violet crystalline outcrops, small chunky snow drifts, sparse silvery conifers and a peripheral stone overlook with crystal-tipped posts. The large center stays plain matte pale snow with only very subtle low-contrast wind streaks; reflective ice and violet glows limited to the far edges. Entrance two broad blue stone gate piers with small crystal finials and a compact snow-capped sign frame. Late afternoon cool sky with a delicate mint/lilac aurora high overhead, but scene and central snow remain well lit rather than night-dark. Restrained turquoise and lilac emissive accents on a handful of crystals only. No castle, no technological machinery, no giant ice arch. A few modular crystal clusters, carved glacier cliffs and snow-capped stone pieces should clearly be producible as custom Blender assets.
